comparator_selection: stronger one-signal arm identity must be frozen from tuning data before protected evaluation; protected results may not select or swap it
family_score: for each task family, average the frozen normalized-point score within arm across the exact frozen model-family set; models/seeds do not become independent N
family_gain: ADAPTIVE family score - selected one-signal family score
hindsight_regret: hindsight-oracle normalized points - ADAPTIVE normalized points, evaluated per family x model and maximized over the complete protected campaign

uncertainty.method: deterministic SHA-256 counter-stream nonparametric bootstrap of family gains

pass_gate_all_required.positive_domains: >= 2 of the frozen 3-domain claim set; if the frozen campaign has more than 3 domains, require positive in at least ceil(2D/3)
pass_gate_all_required.leave_one_domain_out: mean family gain > 0 for every frozen domain omitted in turn

negative_result_policy: Any failed component stops the positive complementarity claim. Do not change the stronger comparator, family unit, threshold, domain denominator or regret definition until positive; a successor must get a new preregistration identity.
